title: Oliver, Keppard, Perez and Bunk: who was the best trumpet
summary: A one-night contest in Chicago putting Oliver, Keppard and Manuel Perez together; each had a different style; comments on Tio and Big Eye Louis.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
